_comment: Which routes and optional segments the GPX export and the brochure maps present. Segment ids refer to data/segments.geojson; the pipeline keeps them stable.

options.name: Manggarai Timur interior loop
options.summary: Ruteng to the south coast at Borong, the unscouted Elar interior, back to the north coast at Pota; skips Ranamese, Liang Bua and Reo.

options.name: Bola south-coast loop
options.summary: Maumere to the Bola coast on the south side of the Sikka isthmus before climbing back to Watublapi and Egon.

options.name: Inerie full circuit via Gurusina and the Sewowoto coast
options.summary: Round the whole cone: Bena to the rebuilt village of Gurusina, down the wild south flank to the sea at Sewowoto (Ena Bhara beach), then the coast road west to Aimere. Network-routed; the middle leg has the maximum remoteness index and is unscouted.

options.name: Wae Rebo out-and-back
options.summary: If the onward trail from Wae Rebo cannot be done with a bike: climb to the village, descend the same path to Denge, then ride the remote-profile road to Todo.

options.name: Boawae to Nangaroro direct
options.summary: Skip Mbay and the Aesesa plain: cross from Boawae straight over to the south coast at Nangaroro. Shorter and less remote; a bad-weather or time-limit fallback.

options.name: South coast direct: Aimere to Nangaroro
options.summary: Stay on the remote south coast of Ngada and Nagekeo instead of climbing back to the plateau: drops Mataloko, Ebulobo, Boawae and Mbay. High remoteness, heavy climbing per kilometre, water unknown.

options.name: Lewotobi southern corridor via Boru
options.summary: South of the Lewotobi twins through Boru on and around the Trans-Flores corridor. Only usable if the volcano's alert level and exclusion radius allow it on race day; the north-coast line stays the primary.

considered_not_offered.reason: A Kelimutu to Egon highland link computes at 120-163 km with 4,700-7,300 m of climbing and would drop the Lio weaving villages, the Paga and Koka beaches, Sikka and Maumere; it contradicts the cultural priority, so it is recorded but not offered.
The coast road Riung to Mbay computes at 48 km with remoteness index 1 (a paved main road); it adds no adventure value and would only make sense inside a re-ordered Ngada section.
